sources.title: Pixelorama multiple authors and file architectures
Nuclear Blaze paid project and trailer

assertions.claim: game:view:uploads now available to third-party OAuth; covers owned/developed/free games and identifies /games/:id/uploads, /games/:id/download-sessions and /uploads/:id/download. Scope is documented; no transfer tested.
Recommended PKCE S256 code flow with system browser and loopback/OOB fallback. Device QR flow requires platform approval.

Owned-key results may repeat game IDs and short nonterminal pages; continue until empty. game.user avatar differs from game cover. /profile/games is developer/edit access, not purchased-library import.
/games/:id/ownership only works with OAuth application tokens for games editable by the app creator; not universal ownership probe.
Free download creates no ownership key; payment for free project creates key. File tiers depend on key price; current uploaded set can change.
Native follow exists; public Follow/Following mixed text does not establish current state. No follow API established; collection mutation is separate.
FlowFit current file 0.3.1.4.zip 8.9MB and compatibility patch 2026-10-27 differ from devlog 641348 old file 0.2.0.3.zip 6.3MB dated 2023-11-26; old accessibility untested.
Creator and community profiles cross-link; public text lacks numeric user ID/avatar. Do not substitute project cover.
LDtk devlog 666042 carries title/byline/body and per-file dates; index exposes post publication times. Do not merge timestamps.
Pixelorama Authors row has Orama Interactive plus OverloadedOrama. Separate Linux ARM64/ARM32 file entries and version v1.2.3; Run tool and Steam widget are separate embeds.
LDtk devlog includes externally hosted inline PNGs. Nuclear Blaze has YouTube nocookie embed zERLzDkyoDs plus ordered images and repeated separator references.
Nuclear Blaze public price $9.99 and DirectX/OpenGL file/version metadata prove paid offer only. No purchase/key/download tested. LDtk purchase surface offers free skip but no skip was executed.

Butler channels create/update file slots; build versions ascend per channel; creator userversion arbitrary. Unauthenticated /wharf/latest channel query yields userversion only if set. Does not prove complete history/download access.
Docs permit one/two columns, inline media, GIF banners and YouTube/Vimeo/SketchFab trailers; custom layout invalidates visual-position assumptions. Actual GIF decoding unverified.
API overview documents browse RSS and global feeds, not arbitrary creator/devlog RSS endpoint.
